codegen_trace.note: Reactive single-controller system: IR-driven obstacle event in, advisory motor commands out, endTask shutdown.
Controller composes Sensor, Actuator, Clock (clockResetTime state variable) and one mode-nested state machine in step().
Three modes; terminal mode named Halted instead of Final per CLAUDE.md rule that the theory-generated controller must not contain a Final state. Semantics preserved: absorbing, entered on endTask.
MOVE_VEL=1.0, TURN_VEL=2.0, OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD=0.5, TURN_DURATION=2.0.
Sealed interface with signal records Obstacle, Tick, EndTask.
Single output Move(lv, av) realised as the multi-arg Actuator.move(lv, av) invocation (RoboChart operation call).
distance() returns latest IR reading; large default (1000.0) when no reading is available.
Stores last commanded lv/av, exposed via lastLinearVel()/lastAngularVel().
Sole sensor measurement consumed by the controller.
Real field reset via timer.nowMs() on Moving -> Turning; compared against TURN_DURATION on Turning -> Moving.
Time source (nowMs) backing clockResetTime.
Moving entry action Move(MOVE_VEL, 0): issued in the constructor on power-up and on the Turning -> Moving branch.
Turning entry: clockResetTime = timer.nowMs(); actuator.move(0, TURN_VEL) on the Moving -> Turning branch.
Halted entry: actuator.move(0, 0) on both endTask branches.
Named predicate sensor.distance() <= OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD guarding Moving -> Turning.
Named predicate timer.nowMs() - clockResetTime >= TURN_DURATION guarding Turning -> Moving.
Field initialiser SRangerMode.Moving — initial state on power-up.
Moving block: obstacle event && obstacleDetected -> Turning with clock reset and Move(0, TURN_VEL).
Moving block: endTask -> Halted with Move(0, 0).
Moving block: tick self-loop, no action.
Turning block: autonomous turnDurationElapsed -> Moving with Move(MOVE_VEL, 0).
Turning block: endTask -> Halted with Move(0, 0).
Turning block: tick self-loop, no action.
Each Beh requirement maps to exactly one inner branch; one extra tick self-loop on Halted (not in SR-Beh1..7) added for bare-precondition cover of the absorbing mode.
